root_cause.repeated_build: The same deterministic website build was recomputed in Required and again by Netlify after merge.
root_cause.expensive_phase: Static locale rendering repeatedly parsed and serialized the same 100+ route corpus; cache identity was not persisted across runners/builds.
root_cause.drift: Production, deploy-preview and local fallback carried duplicated command lists that could diverge.
root_cause.shallow_checkout: Required preflight uses a bounded shallow checkout while material-writeback closure previously depended on BASE...HEAD merge-base ancestry.

prevention.command_authority: One tools/ci/netlify-build-entry.mjs owns the canonical build phase order.
prevention.route_cache: Static locale output is content-addressed by normalized source, translation cache, topology, SEO map and builder implementation and is persisted through GitHub Actions/NETLIFY_CACHE_DIR.
prevention.bounded_parallelism: Fail-closed static locale rendering may use bounded route workers; network translation remains forbidden inside shards.
prevention.artifact_reuse: Required uploads a successful built workspace keyed by the immutable Git tree SHA; production reuses it only after run-authority, tree and SHA-256 verification.
prevention.fallback: Missing, expired or invalid reuse evidence falls back to the canonical full Netlify build.
prevention.shallow_safe_closure: Material-writeback closure compares the two immutable trees directly with git diff BASE HEAD and does not require a merge base.
